verdict.rationale: Official docs explicitly claim support for NVIDIA GPUs, AMD GPUs, and other hardware (TPUs, Gaudi, Ascend, etc.) with vendor-specific plugins, plus quantization kernels tuned per-hardware, directly matching the story. Missing for 10: independent hands-on benchmarks confirming AMD/other-vendor kernel performance parity, and community corroboration is thin/tangential (mostly about NVIDIA usage).
